feed.title: CEZ Job Finder Research
feed.subtitle: What studies say about AI and resumes - every claim linked to its source, every source graded by how strong it is.

entry.title: Is AI resume screening biased? What the studies show
entry.summary: AI models judge resumes differently by name, gender, age and disability in tests. The direction changes by model and test. Real-hiring data is scarce.

entry.title: Do ATS reject 75% of resumes? Where the number came from
entry.summary: No study shows ATS reject 75% of resumes. The figure traces to a 2012 sales claim. Where software rejects alone, recruiters say yes/no questions do it.
